title: Tag-along object follows the incoming missile in the Bluegill Triple Prime report

tellings.quote: Uh but when you did that, you noticed that there had been some object that had appeared on the screen and joined and tagged along following the incoming missile down.

related.note: Both are about the anomalous object seen at the Bluegill Triple Prime test in October 1962. Here it was an object that joined and followed the incoming missile, not material tumbling out of the plume.

plain: During Bluegill Triple Prime, a 1962 American nuclear test fired high over Johnston Island in the Pacific, an unknown object is said to have appeared on the tracking screen, joined the incoming missile and "tagged along following" it down. Harold Malmgren, an economist who advised several presidents, tells Michels he handled the test report himself, and he names John F. Kennedy, Lyndon B. Johnson, Defense Secretary Robert McNamara, National Security Adviser McGeorge Bundy and the Pentagon official John McNaughton around it. If true, something unknown was shadowing a US nuclear test, and it was seen at the top of government.
